verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs describe agile sprint templates, burn-down charts and capacity management, and board/list/timeline views for tracking progress. Together these show first-party sprint planning and tracking for agile software teams. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of sprint-specific workflows (backlog grooming, creating, starting and completing sprints, velocity reports), and independent hands-on corroboration of the sprint features beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: Start fast with pre-built and customizable templates for any project, from agile sprints to marketing campaigns.
Keep work on track whether you're measuring engineering cycle time, burn down charts, or managing capacity.
Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
Prioritize high-impact work, break down big projects into clear tasks, and cultivate ownership.
